name: Polymer to Fiber Engineering Lab
description: Hands-on laboratory exercises covering radical and interfacial polymerization, solution viscosity measurements, melt and solution spinning techniques, electrospinning, fiber drawing and heat-setting, melt flow index (MFI) analysis, moisture determination in PET chips, mechanical testing of drawn and undrawn fibers, microscopic analysis of crystal growth, birefringence evaluation, and crystallinity percentage determination.
